memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Aaron, "You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites." — Num 18:20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is one of the most beautiful verses in the whole book. The other tribes would receive portions of the Promised Land, but the priests would not. Instead, God gives them something far greater than any acreage: Himself. "I am your share and your inheritance." What the priests lacked in land, they more than gained in God.

Pause and let the wonder of this sink in. The Maker of heaven and earth says to His servants, "I am your inheritance." They would own no fields, but they would possess the One who owns everything. On the surface it might look like they got less; in truth they got infinitely more. To have God as your portion is to have the greatest treasure in all existence.

This speaks to every heart that longs for something more than what this world offers. We chase after possessions, security, and status, imagining they will satisfy us. But the deepest human longing is only filled by God Himself. The priests were being taught that God is not the means to some greater blessing — God is the blessing. He is the treasure, the reward, the inheritance that never fades.

For those in Christ, this is our inheritance too. We may not have much in this world, but if we have God, we have everything. The psalmist cried, "Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you... God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever." In Christ, God has given Himself to us and made us His own. Whatever else you lack, if the Lord is your inheritance, you are rich beyond measure.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you treat God as the means to blessings, or as the blessing itself?
2. What are you chasing that only God can truly satisfy?
3. What would change if you truly lived as though God were your inheritance?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You are my share and my inheritance, greater than anything this world can offer. Forgive me for chasing lesser treasures. Help me to find my deepest satisfaction in You alone, my portion forever in Christ. Amen.
